name: A Level History: Annalford
subtitle: A Level History sources, maps
shortDescription: Learn A Level History with maps, timelines, source labs and essay plans on the Tudors, Russia and Nazi Germany. Free to start, optional Annalford Plus.
longDescription:
A Level History: Annalford is an independent revision app for A Level history. It teaches three popular study routes with lessons, adaptive quizzes and interactive labs, and it trains the skills every history paper rewards: reading a source, weighing interpretations and planning an essay.

### Routes Covered
- The Tudors, 1485 to 1603 (16 topics): maps to AQA 7042 option 1C, Pearson Edexcel 9HI0 option 1B and OCR H505 units Y106 and Y107.
- Russia, 1855 to 1964 (17 topics): maps to AQA 1H and 2N, Pearson Edexcel 2C.2 (and 1E to 1964) and OCR Y318.
- Germany, 1918 to 1949 (16 topics): maps to AQA 2O, Pearson Edexcel 1G (to 1949) and OCR Y221 (to 1949).
- Historian's skills (14 topics): provenance, tone, utility, interpretations, causation, chronology, essay planning, levels and the independent investigation.
Other options and the periods after 1949 (Germany) and 1964 (Russia) are not covered; the Coverage screen lists exactly what is and is not.

### Learn and Practise
- 63 lessons with a hook, narrative, key terms, people, timeline, cause-and-consequence diagram, historians' debate, worked example, common slips and evaluation lenses
- 504 original practice questions with explanations, including source and interpretation questions
- Adaptive quizzes that follow your progress and link back to the lesson you need; choose Classical (specification order) or Real-World (big questions)

### Interactive Labs
- Timeline Explorer with strand lanes and an ordering game; Map Lab with Tudor England, Russia and Germany
- Cause Builder; Source Lab (23 constructed source pairs); Interpretations Lab (13 exercises); Essay Planner (22 model plans); a level ladder for honest self-assessment
Essay and source answers are self-assessed; the app does not mark them.

### Made for Phone and Tablet
Text size from 50% to 300% and multi-pane layouts on tablets.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
